sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: With majkinetor's Event Horizon (String Theory) showing: on a page this script supports, Event Horizon's More (⋯) menu in the page header now has "Open in ShowAllEntityData" (what V does) and one "SAED: <button>" item per button of that page, e.g. "SAED: Show all Tracks for Release". Such an item switches to MusicBrainz's page and presses that button, also after Event Horizon navigated to another page inside its view (it reloads into MusicBrainz's page of that one first). The items follow the page Event Horizon shows. Needs the String Theory with the menu protocol (majkinetor's #938); as with V, Event Horizon then stays off for the next pages until you switch it on again.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: With direct Ctrl+letter shortcuts on, Ctrl+L (Load from disk) also made Event Horizon go forward in the browser history. It is now this script's alone there; with direct shortcuts off (the default) Ctrl+L stays Event Horizon's, and inside Event Horizon's view it is always its own.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: With majkinetor's String Theory installed, up to eight corner launchers and its dock sat in the bottom right corner over the rendered table. While a table of this script is shown on MusicBrainz's page they are now hidden (in Event Horizon's own view they stay). ☰ SAED → View → "Show corner launchers" brings them back for the page, "Hide corner launchers" hides them again. Needs the String Theory with the shared quiet mark (majkinetor's #938).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New setting: ⚙️ Settings → 🎨 UI FEATURES → "Hide String Theory's corner launchers while a table is shown" (on).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: ISRC Scout (majkinetor) no longer replaces the ISRC and Links columns of a rendered tracklist with bare copies that have no sort buttons and no 📊, and no longer widens its headings: every table this script renders now says it is this script's (the shared data-mbu-foreign mark), which ISRC Scout leaves alone, and its own hover tip no longer shows over the table. Needs the ISRC Scout with that mark (majkinetor's #938); with an older one, press the Tracks button after its columns have appeared, as before.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Release tracklist with ISRC Scout (majkinetor) since its 2026.11.06 versions: the Links column lost its platform names (no "Links info - Platform" section in 📊, typing "Deezer" matched nothing), because the name moved out of the icons' title. The platform is read again, from ISRC Scout's new platform data first, then from its tip, then from the old title, so every ISRC Scout version works.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The Links icons of ISRC Scout get this script's own card: the platform, "(ended)" and the number of links, then the link addresses; ISRC Scout's own tip no longer shows next to it.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: With majkinetor's Event Horizon (or String Theory) installed, its single-letter keys also worked on MusicBrainz's own page, even with Event Horizon switched off: a stray H went to the editing history (E to the edit page, R to the relationship editor, and so on), and the page was gone, a rendered table with it. On the pages this script runs on, before and after a button is pressed, those keys are now ignored. V (switching Event Horizon on or off), every key inside Event Horizon's own view and typing into a field keep working.

After a table was rendered, in majkinetor's Event Horizon (after V): clicking a link in its view, or pressing one of its keys such as H, brought up the script's "You are about to leave this page" question, even when Event Horizon opened the page in place and the table stayed; and when Event Horizon really left the page (a page it loads, or V after moving around in it, which reloads), the table could be lost without a word. Now inside Event Horizon's view nothing is asked on a click, and the browser's own "Leave site?" prompt comes when the page really unloads. On MusicBrainz's own page the script's question stays as it was.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New setting: ⚙️ Settings → 🎹 KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS → "Ignore Event Horizon's single-letter keys on MusicBrainz's page" (on). Turn it off to give those keys back to Event Horizon. Keys you rebound in Event Horizon are not known to this script.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: With majkinetor's Event Horizon (String Theory) showing when a page loads, which is its default: after switching it off with V, the script's hover cards no longer showed, and the sidebar handle was missing on MusicBrainz's page and on the rendered page. Before V, the handle showed over Event Horizon's own view. The script's floating elements (cards, menus, dialogs, the sidebar handle, notices and the rest) now always belong to MusicBrainz's page: hidden while Event Horizon shows, there and working after V.
